title: Overkill Craft
description: A mod focused on a revamped terrain. With the intent to build massive scale structures.
body:
This mod was intented for an extended building experience. To see massive scale landscapes and take advantage of **Distant Horizons** at its fullist potential. This mods Biggest feature is **JJ Thunder** a World Generation mod. Along with some Utility mods like Backpacks and Waystones, it allows you to explore without worry of needing to go back home. This mod does have an ancient temple below the surface, known to be the **_Sculk Horde_**.

I have also added the **Bliss shaders** to this pack that is **compatible** with **Distant Horizons**. The link to the original source can be found here. https://github.com/X0nk/Bliss-Shader.
